name: corgi-investment
description: Corgi Investment App — Track 2 work trial (monorepo skeleton)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @corgi/api" "npm run dev -w @corgi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @corgi/shared && npm run build -w @corgi/api && npm run build -w @corgi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @corgi/shared && npm run typecheck -w @corgi/api && npm run typecheck -w @corgi/web
